# Tulyro

> Free browser-only tools. No signup. No watermark. Nothing you enter is sent to a server.
> Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser. Results are informational estimates, not
> professional advice. Site URL is a placeholder until the real domain is published.

## Tools

- [Age Calculator](/calculators/age-calculator/): Calculate exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth. See total days lived and the next birthday.
- [EMI Calculator](/calculators/emi-calculator/): Estimate a monthly EMI, total interest and total payment for an Indian loan in rupees.
- [Mortgage Calculator](/calculators/mortgage-calculator/): Estimate a US mortgage payment with total interest and total payment in dollars.
- [BMI Calculator](/calculators/bmi-calculator/): Check adult BMI from height and weight in metric or imperial units, with screening categories explained.
- [CGPA to Percentage](/calculators/cgpa-to-percentage/): Convert a 10-point CGPA to an estimated percentage using the CBSE ×9.5 convention. The result is an estimate.
- [Word Counter](/text/word-counter/): Count words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type.
- [Text to Speech](/text/text-to-speech/): Listen to text read aloud with voices already in the browser. No audio download.
- [Fancy Text Generator](/text/fancy-text-generator/): Turn plain text into copyable Unicode styles — bold, italic, script, monospace and more.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](/dev/base64-encoder-decoder/): Encode UTF-8 text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, entirely in the browser.
- [Invoice Generator](/tools/invoice-generator/): Create a simple invoice in the browser and print or save it as PDF. No watermark.
- [Fake Text Generator](/fun/fake-text-generator/): Make a generic chat mockup for sketches, presentations and entertainment. Export PNG.
